analysis.title: Novo (NOVOb.CO): 3Q26 first take: Strong beat & raise, implying c.3% upside to consensus sales/OP
key_insights: Novo reported 3Q26 adjusted net sales of DKK79,195mn, +8.2%/DKK5,978mn above company consensus of DKK73,217mn. The figure includes c.DKK2bn of positive gross-to-net (GTN) adjustments.
Adjusted operating profit was DKK31,720mn, +11.7%/DKK3,326mn above company consensus of DKK28,394mn. Operating margin was 40.1% vs 38.8% consensus.

One-offs netted to a negative DKK1.7bn: ziltivekimab termination costs of c.DKK1.7bn and CMO contract-related costs of DKK1.8bn (in other income), offset by the DKK2bn positive revenue impact. Adjusting for these, GS says the operating profit beat would have been 17% vs consensus.
Wegovy pill revenue was DKK5,394mn, +17%/DKK779mn above company consensus, largely on higher than expected IO revenue. The pill has launched in 8 markets.
Injectable Wegovy revenue was DKK20,407mn, +2.4%/DKK471mn above company consensus. Excluding the c.DKK2bn GTN benefit it is a c.8%/DKK1.5bn miss, which GS attributes to quarterly GTN fluctuation.
Ozempic revenue was DKK29,706mn, +12%/DKK3.1bn above company consensus, driven by higher than expected IO revenue (delayed loss of exclusivity). The insulin portfolio was +6% vs consensus.

FY26 guidance was raised to adjusted sales growth at CER of -2% to +2% (previously 0% to -6%) and adjusted operating profit growth at CER of -2% to +2% (previously 0% to -6%). The midpoint implies c.3%/3% upside to company consensus for sales/adj. operating profit.

Other guidance changes: FX impact now c.0pp (previously a c.1pp headwind on sales and c.2pp on operating profit), capex c.DKK50bn (previously c.DKK55bn), FY26 FCF DKK60-70bn (previously DKK45-55bn), financial items a net loss of DKK1.6bn (previously DKK1.1bn). The effective tax rate guidance of 21-23% was reiterated.
CFO Karsten Munk Knudsen will leave at the end of December 2026 after 27 years. Luigi La Corte, currently CFO of Galderma, becomes Novo's CFO at the start of 2027.

GS expects the market to take the beat and raise positively and expects the shares to outperform by c.mid-single-digit percent on the day, citing potential upside risk to consensus estimates. GS stays Neutral with a DKK290 12-month price target ($45 ADR).
Implied US net price per script was $398 for Wegovy injectable (2Q26 c.$379) and $418 for Ozempic (2Q26 c.$475).
Novo expects to launch denecimig in 1H27 pending FDA approval, with first launches in Europe planned for the start of 2027.

market_movers.rationale: GS stays Neutral after a beat and raise. The DKK290 price target blends DCF (DKK285) and 13x 2027E P/E (DKK293). Upside is 7.3% on the Danish line and 12.0% on the ADR.

earnings_insights: 3Q26 reported 11/4: adjusted net sales DKK79,195mn vs company consensus DKK73,217mn (+8.2%) and GSe DKK73,286mn (+8.1%).
3Q26 reported 11/4: adjusted operating profit DKK31,720mn vs company consensus DKK28,394mn (+11.7%) and GSe DKK28,261mn (+12.2%). Adjusted margin was 40.1% vs 38.8% consensus.
3Q26 reported 11/4: unadjusted diluted EPS DKK5.80 vs company consensus DKK5.10 (+13.6%) and GSe DKK4.87 (+19.1%). Unadjusted net profit was DKK16,740mn vs company consensus DKK22,584mn (-25.9%).

3Q26 reported 11/4: gross margin (adjusted) was 82.1% vs 80.2% company consensus. R&D costs were DKK15,255mn vs DKK13,141mn consensus (+16.1%). Other operating expense was DKK1,788mn vs DKK73mn consensus.

3Q26 reported 11/4: Wegovy pill DKK5,394mn (vs company consensus DKK4,615mn, GSe DKK4,724mn), injectable Wegovy DKK20,407mn (vs DKK19,936mn, GSe DKK18,925mn), Ozempic DKK29,706mn (vs DKK26,546mn, GSe DKK27,447mn), Rybelsus DKK4,938mn (vs DKK4,753mn), total insulin DKK12,265mn (vs DKK11,568mn).

3Q26 reported 11/4: Total Obesity Care DKK26,146mn (company consensus DKK24,552mn, +6.5%), Total Diabetes Care DKK47,545mn (company consensus DKK43,509mn, +9.3%), Total Rare Disease DKK5,504mn (company consensus DKK4,747mn, +15.9%).
FY26 GS forecasts: revenue DKK324,995mn, EBIT DKK137,552mn, EPS DKK24.25. GSe 3Q26E EPS is DKK4.01 and 4Q26E is DKK4.36. GS lists company consensus FY26 capex at DKK56,249mn and FCF at DKK52,155mn.
risk_factors: Upside risks: faster than expected Wegovy pill sales ramp post launch, and higher than expected peak CagriSema sales.

Downside risks: clinical failure of CagriSema and/or amycretin, slower scale-up of Wegovy/Ozempic manufacturing, stronger competitor obesity data (particularly oral small molecule GLP-1 assets), and deeper and sustained price pressure.
Quality of the beat: c.DKK2bn of the revenue beat comes from positive GTN adjustments, and injectable Wegovy would be a c.DKK1.5bn miss without them.
